environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no application-layer inspection. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from internal VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/8). The migration API is intended for internal developer tooling but is reachable from any host within the VPC. No request body inspection or filtering is performed at any layer.

config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, but accessible from all VPC hosts
